summary: Tested Agenda + Inbox (BE + FE). Backend: 21/22 tests passed. Frontend: login → /admin/agenda dashboard, view tabs (dash/month/week/day), event detail (RSVP, task add+toggle, comment, attachment link), Nuovo Evento editor, admin-bell → /admin/inbox, inbox-read-all all working end-to-end. One backend validation bug found: invalid date format (e.g. '15-06-2026') is accepted with 201 instead of returning 4xx. Frontend editor DOES validate client-side, so real users are protected, but API accepts malformed dates.

minor.issue: AgendaEventIn.date is validated only as `str` — malformed date '15-06-2026' is accepted and stored (201). Per request it should return 4xx. Add a Pydantic validator (regex ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$ + datetime.date.fromisoformat).

issues: Attachment name/url inputs ('Nome link' / 'https://…') lack testID (only attach-link button has one). Add testIDs attach-link-name and attach-link-url for E2E robustness.

action_items: Backend: add strict date validation to AgendaEventIn.date (Pydantic field validator returning 4xx on malformed 'DD-MM-YYYY' style input) — currently returns 201. Same validation should apply to PUT.
Optional FE: add testID to the two attachment link inputs (Nome link, https://…) in /admin/agenda/[id].tsx for future automation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 5608 lines — should be split into routers by domain (agenda, inbox, radio, meditations, etc.) for maintainability.
AgendaEventIn.date lacks validation; PUT re-uses the same model so update accepts malformed dates too.
agenda_comment_delete uses direct authorization header instead of a Depends(require_agenda('comment')) — inconsistent with other endpoints but functionally OK because it checks admin/owner.

rca_of_issue: Date validation bug: /app/backend/server.py L5039 → `date: str` (no validator). Reproduce: POST /api/agenda/events {"title":"x","date":"15-06-2026"} with admin bearer → returns 201 with the malformed date stored. Fix: add `@field_validator('date') def _v(cls,v): from datetime import date; date.fromisoformat(v); return v` and let Pydantic 422 propagate.
